title: The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society (LLS) National Research Registry
official: The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society (LLS) National Research Registry
summary: The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society (LLS) has built a National Research Registry to evaluate real world experiences and medical outcomes for people with blood cancer, before, during, and after blood cancer treatments.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

People with blood cancer, before, during, and after blood cancer treatments.

Exclusion Criteria:

People unable or unwilling to sign informed consent.
